title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4ENVI - Emission
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4envi/Emission. Unwanted substance released into the air, water or soil. Subclass of saref:FeatureOfInterest (ETSI TS 103 410-2 clause 6.2.3.2.1). No location (not a geo:Feature in the ontology).

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'Emission'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

emissionKind.description: Property. Open/enumerated vocabulary, flattened from saref:hasFeatureKind whose range is the controlled vocabulary s4envi:EmissionKind (and its subclasses s4envi:AirEmissionKind, s4envi:SoilEmissionKind, s4envi:WaterEmissionKind) -- none modelled as their own entity. The category of this emission. Known individuals (non-exhaustive, open vocabulary): 'CarbonDioxide' (air emission kind: carbon dioxide, a greenhouse gas), 'HeavyMetal' (soil and water emission kind: heavy metals such as cadmium, mercury and lead, toxic to human health, animals and plants), 'Pesticide' (soil emission kind), 'Hydrocarbon' (water emission kind: chemical compound consisting of hydrogen and carbon).
